Modellen lär sig genom att gissa nästa o: The model learns by guessing the next word across enormous amounts of text, seeing how wrong it was, and nudging its numbers a little. This repeats trillions of times.
Under träning är målet för varje positio: During training the target for each position is simply the next token in the text. Inputs and targets are the same sequence, shifted one step.
Tack vare causal mask räknas alla T föru: Thanks to the causal mask, all T predictions are computed in a single forward pass. That is why training is parallel across the sequence while generation is serial: at generation time the next token does not exist until it has been sampled.
